meta.purpose: LvlUp Ventures scout sourcing pipeline, global programme: India and UAE baseline plus SEA-01 (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia)
meta.program_criteria_source: lvlup_ventures_funding_programs.md (research snapshot dated 9 Oct 2026, from lvlup.vc pages). Only published criteria were treated as mandatory.
meta.scoring_note: 100-point rubric: program_fit 25, eligibility_evidence 20, commercial_traction 20, financing_need 15, timing 10, evidence_quality 10. The fit score is separate from the eligibility status, and a high score never overrides Unknown or Fail. The baseline records were scored with the same weights. Re-score if you adopt a different agreed rubric.
meta.eligibility_key: Pass = every applicable published criterion is supported by evidence. Fail = a published criterion is contradicted. Unknown = at least one published criterion cannot be confirmed. For the Seed Fund and E-Commerce Ecosystem Builders Fund, LvlUp publishes no hard thresholds, so Pass means the company matches the published description only.
meta.financing_need_key: Confirmed = a source shows the company asked for or is raising financing of this type. Inferred = analyst reasoning from stage, model or use of funds. Unknown = no basis. All SEA-01 needs are Inferred.

findings: CPG Fund (equity) now publishes at least $50K MRR, a physical good and a strong founding team. The earlier supplied snapshot said no minimum MRR was published. Baseline alternatives that name the CPG Fund were not re-scored.

Non-dilutive pages conflict on geography: page bodies say global revenue is considered, but the embedded application forms say U.S. or Canada-based brands. Non-dilutive eligibility for non-US companies is therefore kept at Unknown.

Tech Non-Dilutive range is $20K-$20M on the page but $100K-$50M in the embedded form. B2B SaaS page body says $40K-$1M+ MRR and an established U.S. entity while its checklist says $10K MRR and a U.S. entity or willingness to form one.
Seed Fund and E-Commerce Ecosystem Builders publish no hard thresholds; Pass for them means descriptive fit only.
LvlUp Labs page extraction returned nothing and was not re-verified.

runs.status: Completed (below target: fewer than 20 credible candidates found)
runs.notes: Added 14 new candidates. Baseline records were kept unchanged except for additive country, region and research_batch_id fields. Discovery used regional funding coverage (BackScoop, TechNode, e27, KR-Asia, Dealroom, Fireround) via web search and page extraction; some pages were read only through search snippets or extracted answers, and cited-but-unopened links are labelled. Search rate limits ended further discovery, so several headline-only leads are listed in the exclusions as unverified. Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam and Taiwan names were deferred to SEA-02 or recorded as out of scope.
